purpose: Fix gate veto of protective de-risking and degenerate drawdown tuning: mean-variance benefit gate vetoes ~97% of risk-reducing trades (decisions audit of drawdown_budget_v1), and the hard per-scenario MDD mask left every trial mean_utility at -inf so selection was argmax over trial 0 in all folds
finding: Gate fix works mechanically (P90 MDD 45.3%->38.6% for balanced, review 60.8%->47.5%, exempt trades audited) but the breach-probability constraint is structurally infeasible at annual rebalancing: best trials still breach L on 47% (balanced) to 81% (conservative) of training paths, all 5 outer folds fell back to the least-violating trial (derisk_exempt=true, equity_shift=-0.1). Tolerance L=15/25% cannot be honored with meaningful equity exposure at annual decision frequency; position drawdown policies as a risk-reduction route, not a growth improvement at equal risk.
changes_declared_before_run: DrawdownBudgetPolicy params gain derisk_exempt (protective de-risking bypasses the benefit gate, one-sided: re-risking still gated) and equity_shift (optional downward shift of the tier equity cap)

Engine: exempt trades (Decision.gate_exempt) must keep exact cost consistency; benefit inequality skipped only for exempt trades; validation audit independently verifies every exempt trade strictly reduces equity exposure

Tuning objective: maximize median validation CAGR subject to Clopper-Pearson upper bound of P(real MDD > L) on all training scenarios (95% confidence) <= suitability_max_breach_probability (0.20); if no trial qualifies, select the least-violating trial and record constraint_fallback
Search space: 8 combinations = k in {1.0,1.5} x buffer in {0,0.001} x derisk_exempt=true, plus 2 derisk_exempt=false ablation rows and 2 equity_shift=-0.10 rows
tuning_budget: 8 combinations x (96 train + 3x32 valid) x 3 policies per outer fold
tuning_objective: Constrained: maximize median validation CAGR s.t. P(breach > L) upper bound on training scenarios <= 20%; one-SE rule among feasible trials only
success_criteria: P90 real MDD at H=30/cost 0.25% close to each tier's tolerance L (vs 45-47% previously, far above L=15/25/35%); review rate materially below 60.8%; median CAGR not collapsing; drawdown_* remain Pareto-noninferior vs balanced_annual on growth at comparable or lower tail risk
comparison: Direct comparison to drawdown_budget_v1 / drawdown_lifecycle_v1 (same scenarios, seeds, folds) and balanced_annual/cost_aware references

purpose: Per-family tuning grids: in drawdown_gatefix_v1 the global equity_shift=-0.1 chosen under the H=30 constraint double-shrinks lifecycle horizon-scaled equity caps, pinning the 5-year balanced cap on the e_min floor (0.15) and degenerating the budget curve; lifecycle policies declare their own search space
finding: All 5 outer folds selected lifecycle trials with derisk_exempt=true, equity_shift=-0.05 (least-violating fallback; constraint still infeasible, breach upper 0.59 for balanced). Lifecycle H=5 CAGR 2.60%->2.88% with P90 MDD 18.2%->19.5% (cap 0.20, curve non-degenerate); H=15 3.45%->3.62%; H=30 4.23%->4.27% / P90 38.6%->39.1%. Short-horizon trade rates near 100% (exempt sell-back of drift each year) remain a cost concern.
changes_declared_before_run: tune() evaluates and selects per policy family via drawdown_families(config): plain drawdown_* keeps the shared 8-combination grid (equity_shift in {0,-0.1}); drawdown_lifecycle_* gets a dedicated 8-combination grid with equity_shift in {0,-0.05} so the horizon-scaled cap keeps a functional dynamic range at short horizons (5y cap 0.25->0.20 instead of the degenerate 0.15)
Missing drawdown_lifecycle_tuning_grid falls back to the shared grid (backward compatible)
Constraint, objective, one-SE rule and fallback semantics unchanged from drawdown_gatefix_v1
tuning_budget: 2 families x 8 combinations x (96 train + 3x32 valid) x 3 policies per outer fold
success_criteria: Lifecycle short horizons keep a non-degenerate equity curve (H=5 cap > e_min) while H=30 risk stays at or better than drawdown_gatefix_v1; compare H=5/15 CAGR and P90 MDD against both drawdown_lifecycle_v1 and drawdown_gatefix_v1
comparison: Direct comparison to drawdown_gatefix_v1 (same scenarios, seeds, folds; differs only in lifecycle-family grid)

purpose: 方案A：以有成本门槛的风险调整收益替代保护性豁免，检验生命周期回撤预算及交易带的增量价值
completion_result: 五个期限相对三种同初始配置参照均未通过完整预注册增量标准；长期回撤改善伴随超限增长损失，0.5%费用检查未通过。不扩展搜索，新候选保留为研究消融。
verification: 20,640条路径、30,240行指标、552,960条年度记录账本核验通过；独立重放552,960条转换及1,080项标量参考通过；代码和配置hash匹配manifest；统一测试91项通过。HTML资源检查通过；图表视觉验收因审阅账号不可用未完成。
changes_declared_before_run: 新增 Balanced 生命周期预算策略；保留旧策略作历史机制对照，不把旧豁免当作合规新候选
A(w)=1+mu*w-gamma*w*cov*w/2-mean(max(0,1-(1-dd)*(1+R_train*w)-L))，风险权重固定1；B=(A(target)-A(current))/A(target)，仅B>cost+buffer时交易，不使用保护性豁免。年度训练收益用于风险代理，不代表独立路径或路径风险保证
只比较4组 k={1,1.5} x 交易带={0,0.02}，gamma=5、buffer=0、equity_shift=-0.05固定；交易带限制小幅漂移卖回，大幅预算目标下降仍须完整收益门槛
5折外层、3折内层，按H=5/6/15/25/30分别选择；用内层折外路径计数筛选越界上界，不用拟合内风险认证。可行者最大化中位CAGR，无可行者显式选择违约上界最低者；不使用混合均值/中位数的一标准误规则
配对消融共用每折每期限选中参数：零交易带、关闭动态预算但保持同一门槛与复核、同初始配置年度再平衡、同初始配置持有。后两者是诊断参照，不声称满足顾问交易门槛
修补全部期限账本指标覆盖、交易门槛审计、冻结严格JSON及客户确切policy映射；不创建真实冻结包、不执行最终评价
tuning_budget: 新族仅4候选 x 5期限 x 3内折 x 5外折；不调risk_penalty、股票上下限或剩余期限滑道，不根据本轮结果增加候选
selection_objective: 每H内层OOF的MDD>25%概率95%CP上界<=20%，可行者最大化中位实际CAGR；不可行仅研究回退，不视为客户适配通过
incremental_success_criteria: 主风险降低路线：对static/annual/hold三对照分别在全部5期限内合计15比较做Bonferroni配对bootstrap，P90降低点估计>=1pp且调整区间上界<0，中位及P10 CAGR损失的调整区间下界>=-0.10pp/年，至少4/5外折回撤方向一致，0.5%费用H30仍满足同样点估计增长损失及回撤下降；不符合则报告未证明增量价值。对官方等权另报结果。部署适配另要求复核率<=20%、客户风险同时上界<=20%，不以研究回退替代。交易带仅作为消融报告费用/交易率/增长/回撤，不能单凭少交易宣称成功
statistical_limits: 开发情景已反复使用，本轮仍为探索性；bootstrap条件于拟合OOF模型且训练折重叠，不消除选择偏差或认证真实风险；同初始敞口不等于相同实现风险
